option_relations.rationale: Lymphangioma does not match the histologic and clinical findings described
Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma (Dabska tumor) is a distinct entity with different characteristics
Benign lymphangioendothelioma (BLAE) matches the histologic and clinical findings described
Pseudo-Kaposi’s sarcoma (acroangiodermatitis) does not match the histologic and clinical findings described

decisions.rationale: Benign lymphangioendothelioma (BLAE) matches the histologic and clinical findings described, and is equivalent to the leaf label 'Benign Lymphangioendothelioma' with leaf ID 'B4.1'
